testcase.name: Scenario: Apply a customization after reversing a staged command addition: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:940:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Apply a customization after reversing a staged command addition ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Ribbon customization dialog shows All Commands and an empty Part Tools target ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the available list ✔ And the user clicks the right transfer button ✔ Then "2D Sketches" appears in the custom panel list ✔ And the Part Tools target has a pending-change marker ✔ When the user selects "2D Sketches" in the custom panel list ✔ And the user clicks the left transfer button ✔ Then the custom panel list is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list ✔ And the Part Tools target still has a pending-change marker ✔ And Apply and cancels are enabled ✔ When the user clicks Apply ✔ Then the custom panel list remains empty ✔ And the Part Tools target has no pending-change marker ✔ And Apply and cancels are disabled ✔ When the user closes and reopens Ribbon customization ✔ Then the Part Tools custom panel list is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list
